reviews.title: No frills but very efficient
reviews.text: Check in easy, plane on time. Legroom negligible. Food non existent. In flight announcement from captain and crew in very good English. Legroom and ultra small seat spoiled what was otherwise pretty good.
reviews.author: MattwalesNorthWales

reviews.title: Very Surprised!
reviews.text: Was very surprised with this domestic airline. Onboard service was excellent and the crew could speak English. The flight was on time. The only negative was that my wife and I could not sit together.
reviews.author: André K

reviews.title: Best airline ever
reviews.text: Excellent job only is there was a flight from JFK to CTU. Great service better then Singapore Airlines and emberates.
reviews.author: Edward C

reviews.title: No problems
reviews.text: Efficient flight. Did the job well. No frills. Served drinks and biscuits which was just right. Was slightly late on take off
reviews.author: Kath B

reviews.title: well run
reviews.text: Good airline, clean jets. Good price, punctual. They don't charge extra for check-in luggage. Recommended.
reviews.author: Herbert L

reviews.title: Diverted Flight and Left In the Dark
reviews.text: This flight from Zhengzhou to Chengdu ended up taking about 24 hours. The flight was diverted to Guiyang, which is about 500 kilometers from Chengdu. The diversion was due to Chengdu airport being closed due to the dreadful pollution the city suffers from. This, of course, is no fault of the airline. However the dreadful way the diversion was handled is. No attempt was made to communicate with as about what was happening at any time. All information was only given in Chinese, and we were left just to follow along. The hotel we were taken to goes for around $20 a night on line, and that was exactly what it was worth. The only food were given in the 13 hours we were there was boiled broccoli and fried purple onion, which was served for both breakfast and dinner! Finally, we were taken back to the airport way to early and ended up sitting around for another 3 and a half hours. And of course there was nobody from the airline to tell us where to go. Chengdu airlines? No thanks.
reviews.author: Raymond W

reviews.title: Good impression for a first time flight
reviews.text: Very efficient for a flight of just over an hour, onboard snacks not for western taste , bottled water supplied.
reviews.author: Robert Harris
